total.description: Total number of items across all pages

data.description: Page of results. The concrete item type is documented per-endpoint by @ApiPaginatedResponse().

skillLevel.description: The candidate's level on the ticket category's required skill, or null when the category has no required skill

technicianId.description: userId of the technician to assign (D4 — never TechnicianProfile.id)

reason.description: Mandatory (enforced by the P3 guard, not this DTO) when reassigning a ticket already ASSIGNED to someone else.

isAutoSuggested.description: D6: set by the caller when this assignment follows a suggestion read from GET .../assignment-suggestions. Purely informational — the suggestion endpoint itself never triggers an assignment.

payload.description: Front-end deep-link ids (ticketId, reference, and — depending on type — fromStatus/toStatus/assigneeId). Never the comment body.

ticketReference.description: The ticket's human-readable reference, resolved via the entity's `ticket` relation, for the front-end deep-link.

endpoints.summary: Create a new user account and issue a token pair
Authenticate with username/password and issue a token pair
Rotate a refresh token and issue a new token pair
Request a password reset email. Always responds 202 with the same body, whether or not the address belongs to an account (anti-enumeration, P6 contract D13).
Consume a password reset token: sets the new password and revokes every active refresh token for the account.
Revoke a refresh token
Get the currently authenticated user
List tickets, paginated and filtered, scoped by the caller's role

queryParams.name: q
queryParams.description: Free-text search on title and reference (case-insensitive)

endpoints.summary: Create a new ticket
Get a single ticket by id
Update mutable fields of a ticket (role x status rules enforced by the service)
Soft delete a ticket (ADMIN only)
Start work on an assigned ticket (START)
Resolve an in-progress ticket (RESOLVE)
Reopen a resolved ticket (REOPEN)
Close a resolved ticket (CLOSE)
Cancel a ticket (CANCEL)
Suggest eligible technicians for a ticket, ranked deterministically (consultative only, D6 — never assigns anything)

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return (default 10).

endpoints.summary: Assign or reassign a ticket to a technician (ADMIN only, ASSIGN — reassigning an already ASSIGNED ticket requires a reason, enforced by the P3 guard)
Get a ticket's full assignment history, most recent first (§4.4)
List a ticket's comments, paginated and sorted chronologically (createdAt ASC); INTERNAL comments are excluded for a CLIENT caller
Post a comment on a ticket
List technicians, paginated and filtered (ADMIN only)
Create a technician account and profile (ADMIN only)
Update the caller's own technician availability
Get a single technician by id (userId, D4) — ADMIN reads any technician, a TECHNICIAN only their own
Update a technician (availability, capacity, and/or account activation — ADMIN only)
Replace a technician's full skill set (ADMIN only) — previous skills are discarded
List the attachments of a ticket
Upload an attachment to a ticket
Soft delete an attachment (its author, or an admin, only)
List every skill, sorted by name ASC (not paginated)
Create a new skill (ADMIN only)
List the caller's own notifications, paginated, newest first (D16 — no ADMIN override)

queryParams.name: unreadOnly
queryParams.description: When true, only unread notifications are returned. Omitted or false (D18) returns every notification.

endpoints.summary: Count the caller's unread notifications
Mark all of the caller's notifications as read
Mark a single notification as read (idempotent — already read is still 204)
